vat_rates.legal_product_description: "le taux de droit commun de TVA de 18%" — common-law (standard) rate applied, per this Finance Law annex, to operations previously exempt (jute/sisal fibres, animal feed and inputs, fertiliser inputs) and confirmed as the rate against which those exemptions were rationalised.
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of value added tax
vat_rates.legal_reference: Annexe fiscale à la loi de Finances n°2025-987 du 19/12/2025, Article 6 (amending Code Général des Impôts, Article 355 series)

notes: The base rate-setting article of the CGI itself (reported by secondary/aggregator sources as Article 359) was NOT independently read this cycle — only its confirmation via the 2026 Finance Law annex (which explicitly states 'le taux de droit commun de TVA de 18%' while amending downstream exemption articles) was verified on primary text. effective_from is set to the Finance Law's enactment date as the most recent primary-text confirmation, not the CGI's original enactment date (which was not independently verified).
